Enterprise Security Remediation (v0.43.1): Hardened manifest pruning bounds, code-injection/ReDoS defenses, strict Playwright locator allowlists, IPv6/SSRF blocking, exact dependency pinning, and `npx --no-install` CI execution.

High-Speed `cortex explore` & `agent-browser` Native Runtime (v0.42.1): Retired deprecated `@playwright/cli` in favor of Rust-backed `agent-browser` and `npx cortex explore` (direct local bin, CDP handshake/checkpoints, pruned `-i` snapshot deltas, batched DSL, inline assertions, `StateSeederContract` & `FlowContract` compilation, and `--emit-seeder` promotion).
